landing.about_modal_subtitle: An AI-powered policy intelligence platform built for the Higher & Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra — bringing GR search into the 21st century.
landing.mission_text: Maharashtra's Higher & Technical Education department manages thousands of Government Resolutions, circulars, and policy documents. Officers, faculty, and students waste hours searching through PDFs. Vachak Ai changes that — letting anyone ask natural language questions and get precise, source-cited answers in seconds.
landing.data_privacy_text: All data is sourced from publicly available Maharashtra Government portals (gr.maharashtra.gov.in, dte.maharashtra.gov.in) and the open-source orgpedia/mahGRs dataset. Qdrant runs fully on-premise — no query data leaves your infrastructure.

about.hero_desc: An AI-powered policy intelligence platform for the Higher & Technical Education Department — instant, grounded answers from official Government Resolutions.
about.mission_p1: Maharashtra's Higher & Technical Education department administers thousands of Government Resolutions, circulars, and policy orders. Officers, faculty, institutions, and students waste countless hours manually searching through stacks of PDFs to find a single eligibility criterion or deadline.
about.mission_p2: changes that entirely. Using a state-of-the-art Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline, anyone can ask natural-language questions — in English or Marathi — and receive precise, source-cited answers grounded exclusively in official government documents, in seconds.
about.feat_hyde_desc: Generates a hypothetical answer and embeds it for far better semantic search recall.
about.feat_query_desc: Multi-part questions are split into sub-queries, each retrieved separately then synthesised.
about.feat_rbac_desc: Students, faculty, officers and admins each see a scoped view of the document corpus.
about.feat_bilingual_desc: Ask in English or Marathi. Answers respect the language with official terminology preserved.
about.feat_audit_desc: Every query is logged with retrieved chunks, scores, prompt, and response for full accountability.
about.feat_privacy_desc: Qdrant runs locally. No document data or query content leaves your infrastructure.
about.source_gr_desc: Official GR portal — primary source for all Government Resolutions
about.source_dte_desc: DTE portal — circulars, orders, and letters for technical education
about.source_orgpedia_desc: Open-source historical GR dataset by orgpedia for bulk ingestion
about.privacy_notice: All data is indexed and stored locally in Qdrant on-premise. No document content leaves your infrastructure.

about.team_hte_role: Domain Expertise, Policy Validation & Dataset Curation
